title: A WDLoRA-Based Multimodal Generative Framework for Clinically Guided Corneal Confocal Microscopy Image Synthesis in Diabetic Neuropathy
mechanism: Foundation diffusion model fine-tuned with weight-decomposed LoRA, conditioned jointly on thin nerve-fibre masks and clinical prompts.
adaptation: Prompt = source and cell type (e.g. CSIR mono half-cut, BMRK) so every train mask can be rendered in each source style; targets weak sources (BMRK, CFVS without twin) and E1 style.
min_experiment: PF + all train masks rendered in BMRK and CSIR half-cut styles vs PF. Metric CV BMRK inactive/crack IoU and E1 relF1@2. Kill: BMRK inactive CV gain < +0.03 and E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.02.
evidence: R: grayscale corneal confocal microscopy with thin fibres; FID 5.18, SSIM 0.630; downstream segmentation +2.2%, diagnosis +2.1%.

alt_notes.adaptation: Prompt = source and cell type so each train mask renders in every source style (BMRK, half-cut CSIR).
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + masks rendered in BMRK and half-cut CSIR styles vs PF. Kill: BMRK inactive CV < +0.03 and E1 relF1@2 < +0.02. About 30 GPU-h.
